title: How to accept NFC payments as a UAE business
summary: In this guide, we unpack how NFC payments work, how you can use them to grow your business, and how to accept NFC payments with a phone or an NFC card.
body_markdown:

## How do NFC payments work?


NFC (near field communication) is what allows two devices to communicate wirelessly when they’re close together. It’s a short process that only takes a few seconds – you’ve likely seen it when someone pays with a contactless card or digital wallet (like Apple Pay or Google Pay). Any time someone pays by tapping, that’s NFC technology in action.


One thing to note is that


NFC and Tap to Pay aren't quite the same thing


. NFC is the technology that makes contactless payments possible, while Tap to Pay is one way businesses can use it to accept payments.


For example, businesses can accept NFC payments via:


- Tap to Pay on a smartphone:


Turns a compatible smartphone into a contactless payment terminal.


- NFC cards:


Businesses can use physical NFC-enabled cards that customers tap with their smartphones to open a


[payment link](https://ziina.com/business/payment-links) . These can be especially useful for temporary staff, volunteers, or employees collecting payments in different locations.


So… how does contactless technology work with payments? Here’s what happens when a customer taps their card or mobile wallet against an NFC-enabled device:


1. 1.


Tap:


The payment terminal creates a short-range wireless field. When a customer brings their contactless card close, it picks up this field and powers the NFC chip inside. With a phone or watch, the digital wallet may need to be opened first, and the customer may need to unlock the device or confirm the payment with facial recognition, a fingerprint, or a passcode.


2. 2.


Secure payment:


Once the card or device is ready for payment, it sends a one-time encrypted code and a token (that stands in for the real card number) to the payment terminal.


3. 3.


Payment check:


The encrypted information travels through the payment network to the customer’s bank, which checks their available balance and decides whether to approve the transaction or not.


4. 4.


Approval:


The response comes back to the terminal, and if approved, the sale is recorded, and the payment moves through the normal settlement process.

[How to accept credit card payments on a phone in the UAE](https://ziina.com/blog/accept-credit-card-payments-on-phone)


### Different ways that UAE businesses can use NFC


Business type How NFC capabilities can make your life easier


Pop‑up shops, market stalls, and seasonal sellers


You can accept card and wallet taps at festivals, weekend markets, or temporary event spaces. A customer without cash can still pay with a tap.


Cafés, restaurants, and bakeries


Take payments quickly at the counter or directly at the table. NFC helps reduce queues during busy periods, speed up table turnover, and give customers a smoother, more convenient dine-in or takeaway experience.


Beauty and wellness studios


Collect payments as soon as you’ve completed the service and create a premium, “no‑hassle” checkout that matches the high‑end service experience you’ve just delivered. No need to chase invoices or wait for bank transfers.


Contractors or service providers that travel to their clients’ locations


Accept payment right after completing the job at your customer’s home or office. This helps you get paid on the spot and can help reduce the amount of no‑shows and late payments you deal with. Plus, it can look more professional!
